newsitem.title: USA: GM names two new board members.
newsitem.headline: GM names two new board members.

text.p: General Motors Corp said on Monday it named two more directors to its board, increasing the total number of directors to 16 from 14.

GM elected Percy Barnevik, chairman and chief executive officer of ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd, a Zurich-based international electrical engineering company, and George M. C. Fisher, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Eastman Kodak Co.

Barnevik, 55 years old, has been president and chief executive of ABB Asea Brown Boveri since it was created through a merger in 1988. He is currently a director of Investor AB, a Swedish holding company that co-owns Saab Automobile AB with GM.
Barnevik is also board chairman of Sandvik AB and Skanska AB.
Fisher, 56, joined Kodak in December 1993 after serving as chairman and CEO of Motorola Co, where he had been president and CEO since 1988.
"The diversity of experience represented on the GM board is greatly enhanced with the addition of these two new directors," GM Chairman Jack Smith said in a statement.
Including Barnevik and Fisher, 14 of GM's 16 directors are outside board members.
